experiments.title: Rule-based reasoning-unit retrieval
experiments.finding: Rule-based decomposition generated only 1.09 units per question on average and did not improve retrieval.

experiments.title: Oracle reasoning units for sentence retrieval
experiments.finding: Manually constructed reasoning units improved supporting-sentence recall on selected failure cases, but this is not automated-system performance.
experiments.limitations: Small, manually selected sample; reasoning units were written with knowledge of the intended reasoning path.
